cap: Preeclampsia is severe when pressure reaches 160/110 or higher or organ injury appears: low platelets, high creatinine or transaminases, pulmonary edema, or a new headache or visual change. Treatment lowers severe-range pressure, gives magnesium sulfate to prevent seizures and delivers the placenta. Because the kidneys clear magnesium, toxicity shows as lost reflexes first, then respiratory depression and cardiac arrest, and calcium gluconate reverses it.
